<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/actions/{command}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Execute the command declared in the resource type definition on the resource. The request body only allows `id` and `input`: id must be a non-empty string, input must be an object, and extra fields will be rejected.
The specific input, output, and available commands are subject to the runtime definition returned by GET /resource-types/\{type\}.
Common protocol resource commands: the id for create is `protocol:{protocolId}`; when creating a network, do not include parentId, when creating device/point, parentId is required;
the id for discover is `protocol:{protocolId}`; the id for import is the discovery task resource ID; the id for delete is the resource ID to delete, input must be an empty object.
